source_reviews.notes: Read Microsoft-copyrighted (2006) policyDefinitions revision 1.0/schemaVersion 1.0 XML in the official nsacyber repository, policies CustomClasses_DenyRead_Access_1/_2 and CustomClasses_DenyWrite_Access_1/_2. Each uses same-named enable value (1/0), additive List child, and supportedOn WindowsVista. This historical preserved template is not asserted to establish every current installed ADMX schema; modern operation/key/value meanings are separately verified in Microsoft Learn CSP.

source_reviews.title: What is Internet Explorer (IE) mode?
source_reviews.notes: Read engine distinction and supported Internet Explorer functionality, including security-zone and Protected Mode group policies. This supports retained zone consumers, not universal applicability to Chromium navigation.

source_reviews.title: Internet Explorer 11 - Microsoft Lifecycle
source_reviews.notes: Read IE11 desktop end-of-support scope for Windows 10 semi-annual channel and IE mode context; did not generalize retirement to all Windows URL-zone consumers.

source_reviews.title: Internet Explorer security zones registry entries for advanced users
source_reviews.notes: Read Security Zone settings, ZoneMap, Zones, numeric IDs 0–4, action values, and Security_HKLM_only semantics. Article identifies original IE9/IE10 context and warns about IE11 desktop retirement. The attempted https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/urlmon/ne-urlmon-urlzone endpoint was inaccessible; numeric IDs were verified here and against exact CSP mappings instead.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_AppCompat
source_reviews.notes: Read AppCompatTurnOffProgramCompatibilityAssistant_1 and its explicit backward-compatibility-only/current-version invalidity warning, plus exact HKCU DisablePCA mapping.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_Logon
source_reviews.notes: Read DisableExplorerRunLegacy_1 and DisableExplorerRunOnceLegacy_1 descriptions and mapping, including named user values and documented computer-policy precedence. Retained historical wording rather than treating the CSP applicability table as proof all legacy features are current.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_NetworkConnections
source_reviews.notes: Read NC_AddRemoveComponents and NC_EnableAdminProhibits descriptions and mappings; checked privileges and administrator applicability dependencies.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_Printing
source_reviews.notes: Read LegacyDefaultPrinterMode, DownlevelBrowse, PackagePointAndPrintOnly, and PackagePointAndPrintServerList descriptions and mappings; checked wizard-only scope and non-package fallback caveats.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_RemovableStorage
source_reviews.notes: Read AccessRights_RebootTime_1, CustomClasses_DenyRead_Access_1, CustomClasses_DenyWrite_Access_1, and RemovableStorageClasses_DenyAll_Access_1. Verified same-named policy keys versus state values, restart caveat, and broad-denial precedence; CSP does not describe List child schema.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_ShellCommandPromptRegEditTools
source_reviews.notes: Read DisableCMD and DisableRegedit descriptions and their different user key mappings. The DisableCMD section describes command prompt and batch processing but omits an explicit registry value name, so none is invented in the note.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_TerminalServer
source_reviews.notes: Read TS_CLIENT_ALLOW_SIGNED_FILES_1, TS_CLIENT_DISABLE_PASSWORD_SAVING_1, TS_RADC_DefaultConnection, and TS_RemoteControl_1 mappings/descriptions. Distinguished Remote Desktop client controls, session policy, and feed configuration from actual remote sessions.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_UserProfiles
source_reviews.notes: Read LimitSize description and EnableProfileQuota mapping, including local/roaming scope and Windows Vista-era changes to quota responses.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_WindowsExplorer
source_reviews.notes: Read actual descriptions and ADMX mappings for all 20 OpenSearch query/preview ordinary/locked-down zone sections; Restricted Sites differs in unconfigured defaults. Also read NoBackButton, NoFileMRU, NoPlacesBar, PlacesBar, NoEntireNetwork, DefaultLibrariesLocation, and DisableSearchBoxSuggestions. The attempted separate https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/mdm/policy-csp-admx-comdlg32 endpoint was inaccessible; common-dialog policies were verified in this document instead.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - ADMX_WinLogon
source_reviews.notes: Read CustomShell description and exact user System key mapping, including default Explorer interface and replacement-interface behavior; no undocumented value name added.

source_reviews.title: Policy CSP - InternetExplorer
source_reviews.notes: Read AllowLocalMachineZoneTemplate lockdown note: ordinary/locked-down equivalent comparison by Local Machine Zone Lockdown and Network Protocol Lockdown; do not infer feature enablement from key presence.

source_reviews.title: Windows Certificate System Store Locations and Registry Paths
source_reviews.notes: Read CERT_SYSTEM_STORE_CURRENT_USER, CERT_SYSTEM_CURRENT_USER_GROUP_POLICY, physical-store collections, and Remarks describing Group Policy Template delivery and updates.

source_reviews.title: Run and RunOnce Registry Keys
source_reviews.notes: Read exact HKCU paths, recurring versus one-time user-logon behavior, command entry format/limit, ordering, launch delay, deletion timing, special prefixes, and HKLM-specific administrator condition.

source_reviews.title: Merged View of HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT
source_reviews.notes: Read merge rules for HKCU/HKLM Software\Classes and the COM elevation/UAC caveat.

source_reviews.title: Predefined Keys
